const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboWits rcb-limited/2.2 episode controller for place_book.
+
+Run once after the service is ready. The controller uses only RGB/depth, the
+camera calibrations, kinematics, and the robot's proprioception. Movement is
+issued in short feedback-controlled chunks so camera images can be checked
+between manipulation stages.
+"""
+import sys, time
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = "/app/runs"
+
+def pose_pair(now):
+    return [np.array(now[16:23], float), np.array(now[23:30], float)]
+
+def paired_trajectory(start, end, n=12, grip=(0.09, 0.09)):
+    rows = []
+    for a in np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n):
+        row = []
+        for k in range(2):
+            p = (1-a)*start[k] + a*end[k]
+            # Quaternion interpolation is unnecessary for the small moves here.
+            p[3:7] /= np.linalg.norm(p[3:7])
+            row.extend([*p, grip[k]])
+        rows.append(row)
+    return np.asarray(rows, np.float32)
+
+def observe(robot, name):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True, video="frames")
+    obs.save(f"{OUT}/{name}")
+    return obs
+
+def move_tcp(robot, target_pair, name, n=12, seconds_per_row=0.25,
+             grip=(0.09, 0.09), cameras=("ego", "wrist_left", "wrist_right")):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=["ego"], video="none")
+    start = pose_pair(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"])
+    actions = paired_trajectory(start, target_pair, n=n, grip=grip)
+    result = robot.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=seconds_per_row,
+                          cameras=list(cameras), video="frames", depth="none",
+                          note=name)
+    result.save(f"{OUT}/{name}")
+    return result
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    obs = observe(robot, "start")
+    print("Connected; episode metadata:", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
+    # Further stages are appended after visual inspection of the live scene.
+    print("Initial observation saved under /app/runs/start", flush=True)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
